title: Weekend Grindhouse Schedule - Fri 8/21 - Sun 8/23
contentHtml:
Playing this weekend @ 420Grindhouse.

Showtime starts each day @ 3pm EST/12pm PST.

==Friday==

Funky Cheese Friday

  • Bionic Ninja (1985)
  • Dinocroc (2004) aka Primevil
  • Dangerous Men (2015)

Friday Grindhouse-A-Go-Go

  • Contamination (1980) aka Alien Contamination
  • R.O.T.O.R. (1987)
  • Psycho Cop (1989)

Friday Night Freak Show

  • Slime City (1988)
  • Island of the Living Dead (2007)
  • A Time to Die (1991)

==Saturday==

Psychedelic Saturday

  • Beach Kings (2008) aka Green Flash
  • Timebomb (1991)
  • Ticks (1993) aka Infested

Saturday Prime Time Drive-In

  • Naked Fist (1981) aka Firecracker
  • Star Crystal (1984)
  • Zombie Death House (1988)

Red Light Saturday Night

  • Russ Meyer's Vixen! (1968)
  • Wild Things 3: Diamonds in the Rough (2005
  • Night Fire (1994)

==Sunday==

The Sunday Classics

  • The Blood Beast Terror (1968) aka The Vampire Beast
  • Swamp Girl (1971)
  • Necromancy (1972)

Sunday Slop-O-Rama

  • My Bodyguard (1989)
  • The Forest (1982)
  • Out of Control (1985)

Last Call Sunday Night

  • Trauma (1993)
  • The Foreigner (2003)
  • The Empty Beach (1985)
